command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command '$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes").value; foreach($n in $nodes){ $name=$n.name; $u1="http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes/"+$name+"/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $u0="http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/"+$name+"/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $c=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u1).output; $b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u0).output; if(($c -notlike "Error:*") -and ($b -notlike "Error:*")){ $cl=$c -split "\r?\n" | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration|^!Software Version"}; $bl=$b -split "\r?\n" | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration|^!Software Version"}; $d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject $bl -DifferenceObject $cl; if($d){ "=== "+$name; $d | ForEach-Object {$_.SideIndicator+" "+$_.InputObject} } } }'
